reviews.title: The Best Way to Remember to Drink Water
reviews.text:
I am giving this app 5 stars because I genuinely believe it can help so many people. Let's be honest—most of us completely forget to drink enough water throughout the day.

What makes this app stand out is how customizable and practical it is. You can easily calculate and set the exact amount of ounces your specific body needs, and the notification reminders keep you on track without being annoying. Plus, you can even calculate other fluids you drink, which makes tracking your daily intake super accurate.

It is completely free to use, and while there are some optional in-app purchases, you truly don't need them to get the full benefit of the app. It's an incredibly helpful tool for building a healthier daily routine!

reviews.title: Paywall for a sound
reviews.text: I got this app when I started my health journey 3 years ago. I loved it and it helped me stay on top of my water goals. My favorite part was that the notification was a water droplet sound so I knew what alert it was. Now in order to access that feature you have to pay. And honestly I was ready to shell out a few bucks to be able to change the sound but it’s a membership.  They literally want you to pay them $4 a month or $30 a year RECURRING in order to change the sound. Literally have to pay for a sound over and over. Greed is an ugly thing. I would have paid a one time fee for the sound because I get people need to be paid for their work but a recurring payment is just excessive.
